reviews.text: I can't say enough about Elvin. He was and has been extremely helpful with the purchase and setup of our spa. He answered all our questions and assured us that even after the sale if we had any questions or needed help once our spa was installed he'd be willing to help. Sure enough, Elvin has been there for me every step of the way and I'm gradually becoming educated enough to where I don't have to bother him anymore.
reviews.author: michaeltinoco1

reviews.text: Elvin is fantastic. He is very knowledgeable about the spas. We absolutely love our Hot Tub. He listened to what we were looking to get out of our Hot Tub, and directed us to the best one. Plus, it wasn’t the most expensive Hot Tub in the place. He is not about just making the sale.
reviews.author: Jennifer Scott

reviews.text: Great store with excellent customer service! The staff was friendly, helpful, and made the whole experience smooth. I was searching everywhere for spa filters and they were surprisingly hard to find—this store had them in stock and made the process quick and easy. Really appreciated the great customer experience!”
reviews.author: sumpath hiremath

reviews.text: Stopped by to get spa spurge and the cartridges They have a great customer service and friendly staff.
reviews.author: Sam Puddle

reviews.text: Installed our Olympus Spa 2 weeks ago. LOVE IT. Everyone at Southern Leisure was fantastic with all the details. Elvin is the man to see for great information and awesome deals!
reviews.author: carl schweers

reviews.text: We have had our spa w Southern Leisure Spas for five years and are always impressed with the customer service there. By the way, they hve best prices of supplies for our hot tub!! Thank you Elvin and Justin!!
reviews.author: jack vincent

reviews.text:
First of all, we wouldn’t be here without the help and walk through that Elvin Like gave my wife and I. We have been given a white glove treatment since day one when we came into the showroom , from when the spa was delivered and to the point of the technician coming out to make sure we were happy and everything was working properly. If I had to recommend to anyone the top of the line customer service, it’s the Southern Leisure team, hands down the best. Thanks again to Elvin, he made this all happen!
James Cline
reviews.author: James Cline

reviews.text: Wonderful experience with Southern Leisure Spa. Worked with Elvin to find the perfect hot tub for our backyard. Very knowledgeable and great to work with!
reviews.author: Melissa Andreani

reviews.text: Excellent customer service today!! I needed products and education and received both. Come see them for your hot tub needs. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: The Lake Lot Nocona Tx

reviews.text: I purchased a hot tub here in December 2023. Was an excellent experience, as the sales girl was very kind and helpful. Since I have purchased chemicals here and they are so helpful and easy to work with. Elvin is super kind, smart and helpful. Highly recommend!!!
reviews.author: Cori Dossett

reviews.text: The guys at Southern Leisure took great care of me, and I love my Bullfrog. The customer service is top notch! Go see the Happy Hawaiian! He’ll take care of you.
reviews.author: BackwardsHatBooks

reviews.text: Mercedes made our purchase of our hot tub easy, delivery and setup was great . We love our tub and thank you for the awesome experience.
reviews.author: Danny pitt

reviews.text: With Elvin's assistance, we were able to choose the ideal spa. Thank you very much, Elvin. Everything went well with the spa purchase. I was very pleased with the prompt delivery and the precise positioning of the spa by the assembly crew.
reviews.author: Timothy Moreno

reviews.text: Got my Spa from Southern Leisure spa and we LOVE everything about our spa! The people at the store are great to work with!
reviews.author: Brandi Marshall

reviews.text: Elvin was a huge help to me, made the buying process seamless. Will absolutely be back when I’m ready for an upgrade. Love my Bullfrog spa, one of the best purchases I ever made.
reviews.author: Marcus Freeze

reviews.text: Shout out to the store manager Elvin! He was very helpful when I had to stock up on supplies.
reviews.author: Emily Hennessy

reviews.text: I had a pleasure to meet Elvin today he greeted me as soon as I walked in the showroom. I came to the Richardson Showroom needed to purchase supplies for my hot tub such as Frog @ease sanitizing system and additional chemicals. Elvin was so helpful explaining what chemicals i needed Elvin made my purchases very easy. I highly recommend Elvin at the Richardson location for all your needs.
reviews.author: Odette Johnston

reviews.text: Elvin was outstanding! He was incredibly patient and answered all of my (many!) questions. He helped us find the perfect hot tub, and we couldn’t be happier!
reviews.author: Tony Bracciale

reviews.text: This by far was one of the best shopping and purchasing decisions I’ve ever had. Elvin was kind, knowledgeable, and supported us through the entire process, while waiting on our custom spa to be delivered. Elvin followed up and made sure  what we wanted was what we got!  Elvin assisted in grinding a great electrician for site prep and readiness.  Overall process was such a pleasant and honest experience to work with him. Customer service was by far the best I think I’ve ever experienced and I loved working with him.  If you are in the market for a spa or hot tub please, please go work with Elvin. You won’t be disappointed that you did!
reviews.author: LaTeene Martin

reviews.text: We purchased our bullfrog through southern leisure and have had nothing but the best service from answering all our questions to purchasing supplies!! Elvin is awesome
reviews.author: Danielle Haynes

reviews.text: First class place!!!  Elvin Like knows his stuff; no pressure and will work with you to set you up right!  I’m super happy with my Nordic Hot Tub!!   Highly recommend you check Southern Leisure Spas if you are even thinking about getting a hot tub!!
reviews.author: Alan Bonner

reviews.text: Love Southern Leisure Spas, they’ve helped me with everything for my spa. Go see Elvin, he will take care of ya and help anyway he can
reviews.author: Rick Higdon

reviews.text: Southern Leisure is THE place to buy your hot tub. 6 years later I am a happy customer and still come back for all my maintenance needs and professional guidance…and to scope my next new hot tub! So proud to support this community and thankful to be a blessed customer. 🙏
reviews.author: Matthew Lopez

reviews.text:
Horrible customer service, do not waste your time here.

Staff was entirely unhelpful and unwilling to provide me information about the products that they offer. The man “helping” me did not even want to provide me with pricing information and was very condescending. I couldn’t even get  product options, dimensions, etc written down to take home with me.

Overall a very disappointing experience and definitely recommend searching for a different company.
reviews.author: Grant De Paoli

reviews.text: Elvin is great! Very helpful and knowledgeable of spas and spa care. Always able to answer our questions and has the support we need for our spa.
reviews.author: Vincent D Dubose

reviews.text: Great experience with Elvin at Southern Leisure Richardson. We love our spa and the service we receive.
reviews.author: Sherri Williams

reviews.text: Great location great service. I LOVE my Buffldro Stil 7. Get you one!
reviews.author: Al Taylor

reviews.text: Elvin at the Richardson location was as knowledgeable and professional as could be. Helped us pick the right tub for our family. Couldn’t have asked for more!!
reviews.author: Greg Sandberg

reviews.text:
Earlier this year, I contacted this company about a couple of jets that popped off. Chris emailed me back and said the he would get someone to stop by and that it’s under warranty.

Well, that person did come by but could not replace the parts because he said that it was cold and that the water is preventing him from getting the jets in. He told me to contact the company when I drain the tub and he will back to fix it. Well, yesterday I contacted them and they called me today.

They told me that this isn’t under warranty and that I had to pay to get it fixed. I told them that someone did tell me it was under warranty and they said no. The wasn’t willing to work with me and was very dismissive.

I have attached the email to this post. We waited almost a year for this to be fixed for them to backtrack and say that it wasn’t under warranty.
reviews.author: Vivian Namme

reviews.text: I had a wonderful experience at Southern Leisure Spas. Tom Allen  answered all my questions quickly on each and every model that I inquired about. I’m very detail oriented therefore having numerous questions over many months looking for that perfect spa for my specific needs. I can’t even express what a wonderful buying experience this was.  No pressure sales just giving factual information on each spa without delay. When I finally made the trip to the showroom to try the ones I selected all my questions had already been answered and it was a simple try and buy. Delivery of spa was quality quick delivery.  I definitely recommend seeing Tom at Southern Leisure spa in Richardson if you are wanting to purchase a spa.  If only buying a car was this easy.
reviews.author: Karen Bailey

reviews.text: Great service and selection. If you want a backyard oasis this is the place to get it. Their service and craftsmanship are top notch.  Looking for a BBQ for summer grilling, this is the place to go.
reviews.author: Mike Tobin REALTOR

reviews.text: Head to Richardson for all your needs.  We have a Bullfrog M9 and love it.  I also get all my chemicals there - lowest price I find.  Service is also great every time I come in.  You won’t be disappointed.
reviews.author: Alejandro Olea

reviews.text: Elvin was great. Pleasure doing business with him and the company!
reviews.author: Stephen Lade

reviews.text: Mercedes and Elvin at SLS&P Richardson are the people you want to visit if you're ever looking to buy a hot tub. I spent an entire day driving around DFW researching models/prices and this was by far the best option. They're both knowledgeable and attentive to what I was looking for. Other places were expensive and pushy for a sale, but this place takes the time to understand what you're looking for and they have spa in every price range. Save yourself the hassle and just buy from here. Thanks again Elvin and Mercedes!
reviews.author: Rezah amini

reviews.text: Great place to buy a hot tub! Mercedes was super helpful. I had a ton of questions and she answered them all very thoroughly and quickly. She guided me as a first time hot tub buyer very well throughout the whole process. Exceptional communication and customer service from Mercedes! The delivery was seamless too!
reviews.author: Tim D

reviews.text: Everyone need to come see these guy to get a spa they are great

reviews.text: Wonderful experience come see Elvin he will take great care of you.
reviews.author: Mike Ullah

reviews.text: We shopped many places before we decided on Southern Leisure. Mercedes made the entire process amazingly smooth. We have our spa up and running and it is an amazing piece of equipment. Feel free to shop around but you will ultimately end up here!!!
reviews.author: Eric Hoyle

reviews.text: Love my hot tub I bought from Southern Leisure! Great tub and good people!
reviews.author: Don Woods

reviews.text: Elvin and Mercedes are the Goats! Super helpful and knowledgeable. Don’t recommend going to Leslie’s for anything hot tub related…. Elvin helped clear the misinformation and got me back on track!
reviews.author: Chase Hover

reviews.text: Outstanding service and great product. Very happy. See Elvin and he’s got what you need.
reviews.author: Steven Kraal

reviews.text: We had a great experience with Southern Leisure. Initially we were looking at a specific unit we liked but ended up with one we liked even better per Thomas's suggestion. Thomas was patient with all the questions we had being first time hot tub buyers and gave us an honest opinion about the brands we were looking at. They didn't have the specific model on the floor when we ordered but once they did Thomas made sure to let us know so we could come it to take a look. Everyone is very knowledgeable and helpful!
reviews.author: My Hong

reviews.text: Amazing store, great prices, got my hot tub here and love it.
reviews.author: Fugong Wu

reviews.text: Elvin is amazing! Full of knowledge and provides excellent service.  Go buy only from Elvin!😊

reviews.text: Elvin is an awesome manager. He is always helpful to answer questions. We have had the Bullfrog spa a year and it’s still awesome.  Come see them!
reviews.author: Tiffany Langham

reviews.text: Love our Bull Frog Spa…go see the happy Hawaiian “Elvin” at Southern Leisure in Richardson.
reviews.author: Deanna Olivarez

reviews.text: Colby at Southern Leisure was great. He really cares about his customers. The delivery crew was wonderful and I enjoyed visiting with them. They truly care about the customer. I had planted new grass and they left no sign in my yard they had even been here. If you are looking to purchase a spa go see Southern Leisure. The customer is number one with this company.
reviews.author: Marcus Dyess

reviews.text: We bought an X7 years ago and LOVE it! SLSP has taken great care of us and makes it super simple to buy products and ask questions.
reviews.author: Rene Barrera

reviews.text: Recently bought a Bullfrog X8 spa and an Arctic Plunge cold plunge. Our sales person Thomas answered all of our questions, very knowledgeable and honest. During delivery, one of the spa panels had a little damage. I notify the team and they sent somebody else to replace panel. Overall, it was a great experience and we are very happy with our new hot tub.
reviews.author: Mark Maynard

reviews.text: Today, our Bullfrog hot tub was delivered. From buy to install, it took right at 9 mos. I have to say that the customer service we received FAR exceeded expectations. In the beginning, we hadn’t been getting a lot of communication on time line, back orders etc etc. Initially, because of the lack of communication, I  did not leave a good review- the owner himself reached out to us directly the same night I posted the review. He committed to better communication- even with set days and times we would get updates from him. He kept his word and sent an update (even when there was no update to share) every day he promised. You really don’t receive customer service like this anymore- he completely turned this experience around for us. Cole, the owner, even showed up TODAY, for delivery and install to make sure we were taken care of. And when I say showed up… he was helping and working. When the technicians arrived, I was telling them how impressed I was with the customer service and they went on to sing his praises saying he is the best boss they’ve ever worked for. Cole truly cares about his company, his people and his customers. Jesse and Jacob also did a fantastic job explaining everything thoroughly and making it easy and seamless. I HIGHLY recommend Southern Leisure to anyone shopping around for hot tubs right now- you get a lot of empty promises to make a sale in a moment but I can speak from the experience you get top notch service from start to finish here. Big thank you to Cole and the guys at Southern Leisure for turning this experience into something very positive for us!!
reviews.author: Robyn Zapata

reviews.text: We worked with Thomas, and he was awesome every step of the way. Southern Leisure has a huge variety of spas, great opportunities to test, and no pressure ever. Thomas was so patient and knowledgeable, and consistently went above and beyond. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Jennifer Boswell

reviews.text: Love our spa from southern leisure spas. They were great during the purchase process and so helpful learning everything! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Courtney French

reviews.text: We recently purchased from Southern Leisure Spas in Richardson and are very satisfied with the Bullfrog Spa they recommended. Store Manager Thomas greeted us with a smile and patiently walked us through the entire process, asking us about what features we wanted, where it would be located, how it would be used, and never was in a hurry or pushy. He helped us customize the jet packs and and gave us great advice on what accessories were best to add and which ones weren’t worth spending add’l $$ on. From sales to delivery and installation, Thomas was always proactive in getting us updates and keeping us informed. Kudos to Thomas and the entire Southern Leisure Spa team!
reviews.author: John Montgomery

reviews.text: We bought our spa here several years ago.  Very pleased with the quality of our Bluefrog spa.  Service and customer service very good at Richardson, TX location.
reviews.author: Paula Vinson

reviews.text: Tom and his employee are very nice and  helpful and knowledgeable about their hot tubs and walked us thru the whole process from the purchase to the delivery and even beyond. When we have questions we come in and they help us out. As a first time hot tub owner we have questions and they have answers. I would definitely recommend them to anyone.
reviews.author: Don Espinosa

reviews.text:
*REVIEW UPDATE: spa was delivered 12/14. Received great service from Colby who saw my review and did what I was asking for the entire time - set proper expectations and communicated about the product I received. Very happy with the service provided by Colby. Originally gave one star, changing the rating based on the service Colby provided.

4.8 stars?!! HOW?!!! I have had the absolute WORST SERVICE ever. I ordered a new hot tub in MARCH. My original delivery date was slated for August. Not ideal, but understandable with the supply chain issues we're experiencing. It is now November, and still no hot tub. More than that NO COMMUNICATION at all regarding when I can expect my hot tub. I have visited the store and called, only to be told the regional manager will call me - still waiting on that call. I have had better service spending a fraction of what I'm spending with this company. They are great before the sale, but after the sale is dismal. I will never recommend this company to anyone.
reviews.author: Taunya Williams

reviews.text: Elvin is amazing! Full of knowledge and provides excellent service.  Go buy only from Elvin!😊
reviews.author: Vicki Sandberg

reviews.text:
Michael Landon and Zane did an amazing job. Very thorough, helpful and knew their stuff. We hit a couple of snags that could have stopped the install but they walked us through the options, gave advise and we got it done.

reviews.text:
The delivery team, Jesse, Garrett, and Laraby, called to give us their ETA within a half hour of their arrival time. This was helpful. They were driving from the Southern Leisure Delivery and Service Center in Arlington, Texas.

Upon their arrival, they carried the spa we had ordered through the back gate and set it up, with Jesse asking for our input on location.

While Laraby assembled the lifter for the cover, Garrett assembled the handrail.

Jesse gave us the scan code for the spa video and secured the cover straps. He placed the steps and the handrail at the highest spa spot for us to enter the spa most easily.

While we were looking at the spa, we noticed one of the back panels did not have the upgraded neck blaster jet pak that we had requested.  I called the Richardson store and spoke to Jackson. Jesse was helpful in explaining the situation to Jackson. Elvin was not available.

Jesse said he would include the missing panel upgrade in his notes and let Cameron at the service center in Arlington know of this error.  Jesse also answered all the questions we had.

The team was friendly and likeable. Jesse made sure the gate was closed before leaving, so our dogs were safe. He told us to feel free to contact him if we had any additional questions.

We were impressed by and appreciative of this team.

As the wife of an amputee, I'm concerned about activities that can result in the disability of people, in general.  Although they did not complain, I was surprised that this team was not provided with a lifter to transport the spa from the truck to the backyard.

I would like to strongly recommend that Southern Leisure Spas definitely invest in a lifter for this team rather than require them to transport these spas manually, as this can result in nerve damage to their backs and legs and lead to physical disablement.

Hoping to receive the upgraded neck blaster jet pack asap.

Thank you, Southern Leisure Spas.
RGR Nicholas

Update: We were told we would receive the upgraded neck blaster jet pack within 6 weeks. It has been 8 weeks and we have not received it.
